```tok
tok 1.0 "New Application for Registering for an USI course"

pool org "Sports Institute"
  lane user "User"
    start start "Start"
    task select_course "Select a course"
    task select_one "Select one"
    task log_in "Log into account"
    and parallel_start
    task tweet "Connect Twitter and tweet"
    task complete_registration "Complete registration and provide payment"
    and parallel_end
    task receive_ticket "Receive course ticket"
    end end_ticket "Course ticket received"

  lane system "System"
    xor slots_free "Slots free?"
    task show_courses "Show courses and dates"
    xor account_exists "Account exists?"
    xor eligible_uni "Eligible university?"
    task register_account "Register account"
    task request_activation "Request activation"
    task wait_activation "Wait for activation response"
    end end_no_slots "No slots available"

flow start -> select_course -> slots_free
flow slots_free -> show_courses "yes"
flow slots_free -> end_no_slots "no"
flow show_courses -> select_one
flow select_one -> account_exists
flow account_exists -> log_in "yes"
flow account_exists -> eligible_uni "no"
flow eligible_uni -> register_account "yes"
flow eligible_uni -> request_activation "no"
flow register_account -> log_in
flow request_activation -> wait_activation
flow wait_activation -> log_in
flow log_in -> parallel_start
flow parallel_start -> tweet
flow parallel_start -> complete_registration
flow tweet -> parallel_end
flow complete_registration -> parallel_end
flow parallel_end -> receive_ticket
flow receive_ticket -> end_ticket
```
